provenance.statement: This traceability evidence came from a CONTAINERIZED run against grafana/grafana-oss:11.6.5 (compose file docker/grafana/11.6/docker-compose.yml, reported oss 11.6.5) — NOT a live-SaaS tenant, and not a cassette. The container was reached through the repo's established two-seam test pattern with the address-resolution seams ENGAGED: resolveHostAddresses was overridden to answer 203.0.113.60 (TEST-NET-3, which ssrf-guard does not block, so the guard passed on its own terms and no production guard was modified), while the actual dial was pinned to 127.0.0.1 via sendHttpRequest's pinnedAddress. TLS: in-process Node HTTPS terminator fronting the container's plain-HTTP port, disposable self-signed CA supplied to the connection as customCaRef. The revision below is the confirmed MutationApplyResult.appliedRevision from a real executeMutationPlan run whose outcome was "recorded". evidence journal: the shared release journal (EO_RELEASE_GATE_JOURNAL_DIR=/tmp/eo-gate-bIfB/journal) — the evidenceRecordId below resolves there, and e2e/report's generator reads the same directory.
